confusables.note: شباهت ظاهری؛ consume یعنی مصرف کردن یا خوردن، نه کارکشته

homograph.note: Different stress and different part of speech: the adjective is /ˈkɒnsəmət/ (supremely skilled) and the verb is /ˈkɒnsəmeɪt/ (to bring to completion). Only the adjective was tested; the card should show the two as separate blocks and a hint must say which it targets.

senses.definition: extremely skilled at something, or perfect of its kind

examples.en: She handled the angry crowd with the ease of a consummate politician.
examples.fa: او جمعیت خشمگین را با خونسردیِ یک سیاستمدار کارکشته آرام کرد.

senses.definition: to make something complete or final, especially an agreement or a deal

examples.en: The two firms consummated the merger after months of quiet talks.
examples.fa: آن دو شرکت پس از ماه‌ها مذاکره‌ی بی‌سروصدا ادغام را به سرانجام رساندند.
